title: Controller Programming Intelligence
brief: Build ControllerProgrammingIntelligenceEngine that extracts custom G/M codes, macro variable maps, option package inventories, parameter tables, and controller dialect specifics from handbook controller programming sections. Enriches PostProcessorPipeline with machine-specific controller knowledge.

units.title: Extract custom G/M code tables from handbook controller sections: code number, syntax, parameters, description, and which option package enables each code
Extract macro variable maps and system parameter tables: variable numbers, ranges, default values, descriptions, and read/write permissions per controller model
Build ControllerProgrammingIntelligenceEngine: queryable index of custom codes, macros, parameters, and option packages per machine with controller version tracking
Validate extracted controller data against PostProcessorPipeline existing dialect definitions: flag missing codes, incorrect syntax patterns, and option-gated features

exit_conditions: Custom G/M code extraction captures at least 30 codes from a sample Fanuc controller handbook section
Macro variable maps correctly identify variable numbers, ranges, and descriptions with >90% accuracy
ControllerProgrammingIntelligenceEngine returns complete controller profile for any machine with ingested handbook
Validation report flags discrepancies between handbook controller data and existing PostProcessorPipeline dialect definitions
